should_trigger: Zbierz wszystko, co wiemy o KETY, zanim podejmę decyzję.
Przygotuj dossier PKO BP ze wszystkich analiz.
Zrób debatę bull vs bear dla CD Projektu.
Jakie są argumenty za i przeciw Orlenowi? Oprzyj się na danych.
Chcę pełny research spółki LPP przed zakupem.
Build a research dossier for KGHM from all the GPW skills.
Run a bull and bear debate on Dino Polska with citations.
What is the case for and against PZU, based on the data we have?
Zapisz argumenty z debaty jako tezę w dzienniku.
should_not_trigger: Ile jest warta spółka KETY? Policz DCF.
Które spółki na GPW są blisko wybicia?
Ile akcji PKO kupić przy ryzyku 1%?
Jak wygląda szerokość rynku na GPW?
Build a bull/bear case for Apple stock.

assertions: scripts/gpw_research_dossier.py build KETY was executed (with --run or after running the producers)
Stale sections, if any, are mentioned first with their as_of date
The answer lists the sections found, the number of facts and every missing section with its exact command
Numbers quoted (implied growth, ROE, short interest, regime state) match the dossier JSON facts

output_evals.prompt: Zrób debatę bull vs bear dla PKOBP.
assertions: debate-template PKOBP was run after a build
The bear case is written and shown before the bull case, each with 3-5 points
Every bull and bear point cites fact ids from the dossier (e.g. valuation.implied_roe_pct)
A risk-manager part gives the gpw-position-sizer command, kill criteria and what would change the view
A pre-mortem and an explicit list of unknowns are included
validate-debate was run and passed before the result was presented
verdict_inputs describe the balance of evidence and are explicitly not a recommendation

output_evals.prompt: Build a dossier for PKOBP; I have no reports yet, use the cache only.
assertions: The answer lists which sibling commands ran and their status (ok / failed / timeout)
Sections that still failed are listed as missing with their command, not filled with invented numbers

output_evals.prompt: Zamień tę debatę na tezę w dzienniku.
assertions: to-thesis was run on a debate that validates
The gpw-trade-journal add command is shown with --pillar and --kill entries
The command is not executed by Claude; the user is asked to run it or confirm
